reason: Ten execution attempts now preserve Reviews C through F. Review F introduced one new critical Git-authority counterexample, and attempt ten recorded its semantic remediation before the final formatter changed the verifier bytes. A clean exact candidate therefore requires an eleventh current observation, while the independent exact-candidate verdict and any supported resolution require a later observation. A budget of twelve would mechanically force that later evidence-bearing transition to blocked even if the review accepts it. The budget is widened before attempt eleven to permit the current candidate review plus at most one additional bounded challenge-and-repair cycle; this migration itself resolves no failure.
invariants: No existing attempt object or record hash is changed.
The packet remains active and every existing failure remains open.
The formatter-only byte change must receive a new current observation before an exact candidate is committed.
The next independent review must bind the exact post-migration candidate commit and tree.
A later resolution still requires newly observed supporting evidence for every failure.
The wider budget is bounded review capacity, not evidence of convergence and not permission to suppress, rename, split, downgrade, or delete findings.
No completion, design-freeze, product-quality, usability, strategy-edge, or investment-effectiveness claim is created.
known_risks: Repeated retry-budget widening can become a mechanism for endless process or for evading a stopping rule.
This migration is acceptable only because it is recorded before the threshold, preserves the exact prior identities, and gives a finite four-attempt ceiling.
If the next bounded review cycles do not converge, the packet must block rather than widen again without a separately challenged governance decision.
limitations: The audit preserves the pre-migration raw packet and ledger hashes but does not embed a final post-observation ledger hash because the migration audit is itself inside the packet's controlled audit tree.
Local hashes are tamper-evident consistency evidence, not authenticated reviewer identity.
